title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1973-03-28

ai_review.summary: High‑energy March ’73 show with a smoking Dark Star and tight Workingman's Dead → Playin' sequence; soundboard sections are crystal clear while audience portions have modest flaws.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its tight playing, especially the expansive Dark Star that flows into Eyes of the World and Playin' in the Band, plus an up‑tempo version of 'They Love Each Other'. Soundboard tracks (disc 3) are excellent, but the audience recordings suffer from occasional muddiness and dropouts. Overall the show is regarded as a memorable gem from early 1973.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and enthusiastic comments about the music indicate a strong show; recording quality is mixed but soundboard portions are excellent, yielding an overall rating in the good–great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Disc 3 (WRS Prelude → JB Goode) is sourced from the soundboard and is crisp. The audience‑sourced sections are described as having problems – muffled, occasional dropouts, and less clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note a tight, well‑sequenced set with strong transitions, especially the WRS→Dark Star→Playin' stretch; some miss the WRS in certain cuts but overall flow is praised.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring guitar tone, inventive improvisation, and use of a Crybaby wah‑wah pedal during this era.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for 'amazing notes' on bass during the wide‑open Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is mentioned using a volume pedal on piano; early keyboard effects are noted as part of the show’s character.
